summary.text: Keisha Lance Bottoms is a former Atlanta mayor and Biden White House official. She is campaigning on expanding Medicaid, lowering driving costs, a statewide affordable-housing trust fund, and repealing Georgia's abortion restrictions.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Florida A&M University and a law degree from Georgia State University; worked as an attorney and magistrate judge.
Elected to the Atlanta City Council in 2009 and re-elected in 2013, representing District 11.
Served as Atlanta's 60th mayor from 2018 to 2022, then as director of the White House Office of Public Engagement in the Biden administration.
